profile.headline: Sr. Software Engineer | Fluent in English, Chinese, Japanese | .NET, C#, Agile
profile.summary:
In addition to my software skills, I would like to add my language teaching skills. I was a Chinese tutor hired by Asahi corporation when I lived in Tokyo for 4 years. I also was a Chinese teacher in a Chinese Saturday school for years, and later on did private teaching for couple of years. I am very interested in languages and am interested in these types of job opportunities, such as teaching, recruiting or bilingual project manager.

Sr. software Engineer or project manager prefer with multinational teams. I have extensive product design, project management and development experience working internationally, Native level spoken and written fluency in Chinese, English and Japanese (N1)

I have worked in software development for 20 years. I’ve had the opportunity to both develop web applications for the financial industry and to develop image sensor testers for the Semiconductor industry.  In both areas, I was a core member of the development team, and also was a leader for many of the projects.

I was a manager in China for 5 years, also held leadership positions in Japan and the US.  I have lead many projects to successful completion.

Specialties: Strong project management/project lead experiences under international environment. Strong software experience.

Strong communication skills.
Familiar with Agile/Scrum, ISO and CMMI.

Develop environment: MS Visual Studio, Windows
Programming Languages: C, C++, C#, VB6, Python
Revision control: SourceSave, ClearCase, Git, TFS
Web development: ASP.NET MVC2/3/5, ASP.NET, ADO.NET, IBM SQL, MS SQL Server 2016, XHTML, JavaScript, CSS, jQuery/Ajax, Bootstrap 3/4

Foreign Language:  Fluent in spoken and written English, Japanese (JLPT level 1) and Chinese(Native level).

positions.title: Sr. Software Engineer
positions.description:
Developing optimum safety and risk management systems, guidelines and standards, and audit protocols worldwide. It helps companies comply with local, state and federal PSM regulations, as well as minimize loss of life, environmental impact, equipment damage. 

I worked on design and develop Process Safety and Risk Management next generation web application utilizing new technologies, .NET Framework 4.5, ASP.NET, Angularjs, ASP.NET MVC, JSON and Entity Framework, REST API, Javascript/JQuery, Bootstrap 3/4, Html, CSS, SOAP Webservices, MS SQL server, TFS, Agile, 

 -Digital signature embedded (DocuSign) to PSE platform
 -Integration with our PSE and PSL software platforms
 -Action tracking system for projects, workflows with auto notifications
 -A self-hosted Web API for our accounting security information process
 -Big data analysis system (KPI) to benchmark the usage of the critical process safety data.
Charting (google chart, chart.js), Table (auto sorting, pagination)
 -POM (Process Opportunity Market) web application for PSE contractors and experts
 -Auto generate reports itextsharp. pdf converting
 -Redesign the web application with responsive pages Bootstrap, customer css
 -Creating large document, user account, security management trees on demand using jstree
 -Windows email service engine

positions.title: Sr. Software Engineer
positions.description:
We are creating automated testing environment for semiconductor industry. I was the design lead for many of our J750 projects. I have worked closely with marketing, field applications, software and hardware engineers gathering user requirements, writing high-level design and test documents. During the development phase, I have managed a group of software engineers for coding, testing and verification.  I also was a main developer for these projects. One of our products was nominated as the best test platform for year 2014.

-	Leading a group of team from project initiation to success.
-	Working on very large code bases, from UI design, business logic to the databus communication.
-	Worked on 32bit application conversion to 64bit application. Focus on memory reduction and performance improvement. 
-	Developed tools for performance comparison using C++/CLI vs. C# CCW.
-	Code reviews, unit testing, assistant to QA for system verification testing.
-	Troubleshooting and debugging skills.
-	Software development under CMMI processes.
-	Experienced C#.NET4.5, C/C++, WinForms, VB.

In my spare time, I have consistently studied and learned new computer languages; I have experienced to use latest version of ASP.NET MVC creating a utility tool for displaying the test results. This web application receives user’s search criteria, passes it to python parse engine and receives the results for displaying. 
I have also worked on Angular2 along with Flask framework for teaching and developing a project with a small group of people. It is a trip sharing system, allowing people to provide their locations and dates of visit to share.
positions.insights: Skills: Project Management · Programming · English · Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) · Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) · Python (Programming Language)

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer
positions.description:
We provide financial analysis web applications based on Asset Backed Securitization for financial professionals, such as underwriters, issuers and loan officers.  Our new ABSNet application has fast search functionality to the world wide deals/bonds information, generates deal’s snapshot, data viewer and report library to help the professionals to make corresponding decisions.

Lewtan provides web based products for Asset Backed Securitization to finance professionals, such as underwriters, issuers and loan officers. I joined in the company to develop a new web platform.

I was the user interface design lead and developer to the new web application.  I had extensive coding, testing experience on both GUI and server using ASP.NET, MVC, ADO.NET, Web Service, WCF, C#, JavaScript, JQuery, Ajax, XHtml, CSS and MS 2008/2010 SQL server.

-	Platform application developed in C# using ASP.NET MVC framework.
-	Developed web applications with Ajax, JQuery, JavaScript and CSS.
-	Responsible for web applications release and deploy process using IIS.
-	Experienced with SQL Server and stored procedures.
-	Experienced with Web service, WCF.
-	Some of experience with Entity Framework. 
-	Lead a group of developers.
-	Working closely with marketing, sales, design team and QA.
-	Responsible for technical requirement, design, coding as well as testing.
-	Responsible for writing project design document and release notes to QA team.
-	Agile development process
positions.insights: Skills: Cascading Style Sheets (CSS) · Scrum · Programming · English · Agile Methodologies · ASP.NET · ASP.NET AJAX · HTML · Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) · Object-Oriented Programming (OOP)

positions.title: Sr. Software Engineer
positions.description:
Developed IP750 CMOS/CCD devices capture driver system for testing camera image sensors. This was a large project requiring cross functional, cross country communication, discussion for the complicated design, coding and testing. I was the software lead, managed a multi-functional group located in US, Japan, Taiwan and Korea for system requirements gathering, risk assessment, and was a primary designer for the capture driver system.  During the development time, we faced significant performance issue for running large image size (32 devices, 1024pin with maximum 64M pixel image size) testing and I proposed and designed a multi-threaded data processor to increase the image processors throughput. 

For another performance issue, I also managed a group of contractors developing data conversion algorithms from imaging device hardware specifications to software driver.

Beijing-Renesas project was another mid-size project I managed. The purpose of this project was to replace old generation of tester computers that were developed in 70th to the new testers for Renesas China. I was one of the mangers responsible for analyzing the business model research and development.
positions.insights: Skills: Project Management · Programming · English · Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) · Object-Oriented Programming (OOP)

positions.title: Sr. Software Engineer
positions.description:
Joined in as a software engineer, move COM, C/C++, VB3/VB6 in house applications to web based Microsoft ASP.Net applications.  Developed financial based web applications (XP2 platform) in ASP.NET and C#. Created JavaScript, CSS, HTML, XML, SQL queries and stored procedures with SQL server.

Project leader for Cash Dispenser Machine Interface (CDMI) for both Delarue and Diebold ATMS, worked on the loan origination booking system, financial transaction platform, loan insurance calculation engine, credit bureau report parsing system, as well as the credit score tracking system for Experian, Equifax, and TransUnion.
-	Web application developed in C# using ASP.NET, ADO.NET framework.
-	Experience C#, JavaScript, CSS, HTML, XML
-	Experienced with SQL Server and stored procedures in MS and IBM SQL server.
-	Lead a small group of developers.
-	Working closely with design team and QA team.
-	Working closely with customer team, on emergency calls from our credit unions.
-	Responsible for technical requirement, design, coding as well as testing.
-	Responsible for writing project design document and release notes to QA team.
-	Agile development process.

positions.title: Director of Student Affairs Office
positions.description:
I had been studying and obtained the MBA degree when I was working in the Chengdu University after my first EE graduation.   The MBA was to educate the future leaders for all universities in the whole China. After the graduation, I became the League Secretary in the university, and after 2 years, I became the Director of Student Affairs Office.  

Technology development management, had experiences on how to manage software and hardware engineer groups to develop hi-tech project with universities professors’ help.  Also coordinate with others, such as marketing and sales.
